tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Ski Club of Great Britain website content (articles, holidays, ski tests, discounts, resorts, reps, shop products). Returns matching documents with title, url and excerpt. Use `type` to filter by content type (e.g. holiday, sc_resort, page, product).

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full content of one document by the id returned from `search`.

tools.name: find_resort
tools.description: Find a ski resort by name and return its numeric id (pass to get_resort_conditions and get_resort_cards) plus its page url.

tools.name: gget_resort_conditions
tools.description: Current snow/lift/weather conditions plus forecast for one resort. Anonymous callers receive current conditions in full and a 3-day forecast. Set include_forecast=false for just the current conditions (much smaller response).

tools.name: get_resorts_conditions
tools.description: Current conditions + forecast for several resorts at once (max 50 ids).

tools.name: get_resort_cards
tools.description: Resort card metadata (name, country + flag, slug, url, images) for one or more resort ids (max 50).

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Detail for one holiday/tour by its Sugati/Salesforce tour id. Get the id from a holiday's `tour_ids` in a `search`/`fetch` result.

tools.name: list_help_topics
tools.description: List the Ski Club help (FAQ) topics: slug, name, intro, number of FAQs and the topic's help page url. Pass a slug to get_help_topic.

tools.name: get_help_topic
tools.description: The questions and answers (Markdown) in one help topic, in the site's order, with each FAQ's url. Paged: pass `offset` from `next_offset` for more.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: One help FAQ by its slug: question, answer (Markdown), url, topic and related questions.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the Ski Club help FAQs (membership, digital passes, holidays and more) for a question. Every word must match; returns answers in Markdown with urls. Prefer this over `search` for 'how do I…' / policy questions.

tools.name: get_page_faqs
tools.description: The FAQs shown on one site page, holiday, resort or ski test, in page order, with answers in Markdown. Give exactly one of `path`, `holiday`, `resort` or `ski_test`. For a holiday, add its resorts' slugs in `with_resorts` to include their FAQs too (as the holiday page does).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List shop products (title, price range, availability, variants).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one shop product by its handle.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Get one shop collection and its products by handle.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
